# Steam Vault v1.2.0

**Release date:** 2026-10-15
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning

## ✨ Highlights

Steam Vault v1.2.0 delivers complete metadata and artwork pipeline parity between the desktop organizer and the Community Game Catalogue, introducing seamless multi-provider cascades across Steam Store, Community Catalogue, GOG, PCGamingWiki, Wikipedia, Libretro Emulation Thumbnails, VNDB, SteamGridDB, and IGDB.

In addition, v1.2.0 introduces keyword-based artwork search with automatic dead link filtering, custom game display name overrides persisted locally, full multilingual game metadata support integrated with our 30-language i18n engine, and consolidated Settings section tabs.

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

- **Multi-Provider Metadata & Artwork Pipeline Parity** — Unified metadata resolution cascading across Community Catalogue, Steam Store, GOG, PCGamingWiki, Wikipedia (with high-res box art), Libretro Emulation Thumbnails, VNDB, SteamGridDB, and IGDB. Defunct RAWG has been permanently excluded.
- **Backend & Frontend Metadata Refresh** — New `refresh_game_metadata` command for single-game and library-wide metadata synchronization. Added a "Fetch & Refresh Library Metadata" action in Settings with auto-artwork download, and prominent "Refresh Metadata" buttons on game details pages and management modals.
- **Keyword-Driven Artwork Search & Dead Link Culling** — Artwork searches are now keyword-driven across all 5 visual slots (grid portrait, grid landscape, hero banner, logo, icon). Dead or unreachable CDN URLs are automatically filtered out via client-side error handling to eliminate broken image cards.
- **Custom Display Name Override** — Embedded management modal allowing users to customize display names for any library game, seamlessly reflected across topbars, capsule cards, and hero views.
- **Cross-Repo Multilingual Game Metadata** — Integrated `locales` support in `AppMeta` dynamically displaying localized game titles and short descriptions according to the user's active language from Steam's 30 platform languages.
- **Settings Navigation & Tab Consolidation** — Consolidated Collections, Platforms & Launchers, and Library Organization into modular, dedicated section tabs within Settings, streamlining the top navigation.

## ✅ Changed

- **Visual Provider Dropdown** — Expanded artwork provider filter with discrete selectors for Community Catalogue, GOG, Wikipedia, PCGamingWiki, VNDB, Emulation, SteamGridDB, Steam Store, IGDB, and Metadata.
- **Artwork Safe Search & Animation Filters** — Tabbed artwork manager features toggleable safe search (NSFW filter) and static vs. animated asset filters matching Steam's desktop client standards.

## 🔍 Platform / Compatibility Matrix

- **Windows**: Windows 10 (1809+) & Windows 11 (x64, arm64). Built as `.msi` (WiX) and `.exe` (NSIS).
- **macOS**: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later. Built as universal binary `.dmg` (Apple Silicon `aarch64` & Intel `x86_64`).
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 38+, Arch Linux, and standard systemd/glibc distributions with WebKitGTK 4.1. Built as `.deb` and `.AppImage`.
- **Mobile (Android / iOS)**: Explicitly unsupported.

## 🛠️ Build, Installation & Verification


- **Frontend verification**: `npm run check` (`svelte-check`) passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- **Static bundle compilation**: `npm run build` completed cleanly in 9.5s.
- **Catalogue synchronization**: Validated with 729/729 games.
